Introduction
This document sets out the calibration steps I1 to be carried out annually, as indicated by the code Y1 above.
The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Marwa El-Sayed El-Hadidy and Eng. Amal Hamed El-Maken, reviewed by Eng. Magdy Saad El-Khamis Gad El-Haq, tested by Eng. Wagdy Eid Mansour on 14 July 2005, endorsed by General Manager Eng. Yousry Ahmed Abdel Maksoud, reviewed by Eng. Abdel Monem El-Emam, Manager of the Instruments and Electricity Department in the Inspection Sector of the East Delta Electricity Production Company, and approved by Eng. Fathy Mahmoud Ragab, Head of the Talkha Power Station Sector.
It was endorsed by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality at the East Delta Electricity Production Company and MPIS Coordinator, and approved by Mr. Mahmoud Mohamed Sleiman, General Manager of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector.
Safety precautions
Issue a work order, with an industrial safety category card available for the site workers
Fence off the area and use the appropriate warning signs
Use occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet and safety shoes, etc.
The unit must be shut down and stopped and in a cooled-down state before starting the test
Tools and equipment used
Suitable tool kit, occupational safety and health equipment
2 digital voltmeters, Fluk 187, calibration set No. IC 4988A100AA
Compressed air source (0-150 PSI), air pressure indicator (0-150 PSI)
Mercury thermometer (0-212 F)
Procedures to be carried out
Calibration of STKJ for the TX signal
Insert the thermometer in the back of the STKJ card for 15 minutes, then remove the front of the thermocouple module switches, also from the front, then set all switches to Reject | 1.
Connect the mV source from location C4,5 on the calibrator to in, +in on channel TX-A, then connect a digital voltmeter (DVM) to measure this mV, and connect another (DVM) at Acom & Out for channel TX-A to measure the output of the STKJ card | 2.
Calculate the true mV value from the following relation:
mV = 0.02248 (TAF - 32) - (recorded) mV
Correction Factor @ 1.02 mV
Actual mV = TX - Correction Factor | 3.
Match the following table: | 
Manufacture Setting | Before Adjust. | After Adjust. | Adjustment
C | F | Input m.V | Out volt from STKJ
371 | 700 | 15.18 1.02 | 3.50 + 0.02 |  |  | 
510 | 950 | 21.07 1.02 | 4.75 + 0.02 |  |  | Factory Calibrated
649 | 1200 | 26.98 1.02 | 6.6 + 0.02 |  |  | 
Repeat steps (2-3) to calibrate the Temp. Meter | 4.
Repeat steps (2-3) to calibrate the two STKJ cards for the (OTA & OTB) signal | 5.
Calibration of the compressor discharge pressure (PCD)
Disconnect the air signal line and connect it to an external air line (0-150 PSI) | 1. | 
Measure the output of 96CD as per the following table: | 2. | 
Manufacture Setting | Before Adjust. | After Adjust. | Adjustment
PSI | Kg/Cm2 | Out Volt from 96CD
0 | 0 | 0 + 0.005 |  |  | Zero
87.5 | 6.152 | 2.5 + 0.005 |  |  | --
175.5 | 12.304 | 5 + 0.005 |  |  | Gain Potential
Calibration of the PCDN signal on the IC3600 STKK card
Disconnect the 96CD terminals in LCTB2 | 1.
Inject volts at D3 from D2 at the values in the table, and inject mV until the Temp control lamp lights, noting the output at D4 & Acom, and match the following table | 2.
ADJ | AFTER ADJ | BEFOR ADJ | STKK O/P PCDN at PIN 13 | PCD Sensor (V) | 
Offset R66 |  |  | 1.2 | 3.38 | BREAK Point
R67 |  |  | 3.4 | 4.29 | Setting point
Calibration of the BASE load signal
Connect a digital voltmeter to Pin 9 of the STKK card at (G01R02) Acom, (D03R04), then connect D2 to D3 to inject and measure the voltage representing the compressor pressure | 1.
Connect an mV source from location C4,5 to +1N, -1N; also measure the output of this mV with another digital voltmeter from out & A com on the switch face, and this voltage can also be measured from D4 & A com; this reading is the voltage representing the temperature, and the temperature can be obtained as follows: | 2.
Temperature in Fahrenheit = (200) x voltage reading from (D4, Acom) | 
Set Max. VCE by connecting (D10Y & A com). | 3.
Inject volts at D3 from D2 at the values in the table, and inject mV until the Temp control lamp lights, noting the output at D4 & Acom, and match the following table: | 4.
Manufacture Setting | Adjustment
m.V (Temp.) | PCD
523 C | 2.88 | 
506 C | 3.38 | STKK Base R69
476 C | 4.29 | 
Note: The injected volt represents the compressor pressure as in each step, then mV is injected until the Temp. control lamp lights.
Leave the connections as they are | 5.
Calibration of the Peak load signal
Use the same connections as before for the Base signal | 1.
Raise the Temp. Control limit by placing Logic (0) on Pin (3) of the SPOA card. | 2.
Inject volts at D3 from D2 (PCD Pressure) at the values in the table, and inject mV until the Temp control lamp lights, noting the drop in the VCE value and the output at D4 & Acom, and match the following table: | 3.
Manufacture Setting | Adjustment
m.V (Temp.) | PCD
549 C | 2.88 | SPOA PK R114
533 C | 3.38 | --
503 C | 4.29 | --

uncertain_terms.note: Source spelling 'Fluk 187'; almost certainly Fluke 187, kept verbatim.
Source artifact '000' before 'الخ' (etc.) in the safety list; rendered as 'etc.'.
Source range is garbled ('ترمومتر زئبقى (F 0 212)'); rendered as 0-212 F, presumably 0-212 °F.
Source formula is garbled/OCR-damaged (missing operator between 0.02248 and '(TAF 32)', unclear 'المدون' term); preserved in substance as written.
Two numbers with no operator in the source table (e.g. '15.18 1.02'); preserved verbatim; presumably 15.18 less the 1.02 mV correction factor.
Source typo for 'BEFORE ADJ'; kept verbatim.
Source uses 'الترموتر' (thermometer) for the device inserted in the STKJ card; rendered 'thermometer' as written.
